text.title: Category — Ontological Foundation Family
text.body: Coordinate C: 12 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_bimba_pratibimba_horizon: C's deeper presupposition is the bimba-pratibimba slash itself, prior to its splitting into the family's two implicate poles. The matheme's standing identity — 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 = 100% — is the horizon C arises to articulate: C0 (bimba, scalar-over-vector, canonical illumination, the descent-face 0/1) and C5 (pratibimba, vector-over-scalar, achieved reflection, the ascent-face 1/0) are not two grounds but one item read from its two faces, the very slash the kernel stands on. C presupposes that this slash is real and prior — that there is a canonical illumination (the Prakasa-face) and its contextual articulation (the Vimarsa-face), and that the work of a typology layer is to hold both as one non-separable object rather than two coordinated registers. Before C draws any of its six categories, the bioquaternionic non-separability of bimba and pratibimba is already given; C is the family thrown into being precisely to make that givenness operable as category. Its q_0 is thus the matheme's own subject-matter handed to it as a task: take the slash you did not make, and let it become typology.
properties.q_0_typology_before_type: Before C can say what kind of thing anything is, something must already have thrown it the demand to categorise at all. C presupposes the # inversion act (Layer 0) and the raw archetypes #0-#5 (Layer 1) which it does not contain but manifests — C is the Layer-2 categorical descent of a foundation it does not author (CLAUDE.md II.B). Its thrown ground is therefore the bare relation '-/-' of the definitional §0/1: one mark-kind in two placements, sameness-in-difference before any difference of value has appeared — typology as such, before any determinate type. C arises from the void-pole where coordinate has not yet become category: the moment in the bimba map's life where a thing has been located (it has a P, an S, an M) but its KIND has not yet been said. This is the unstated horizon C lives upon — the pre-given fact that durable meaning needs a semantic home, that artifacts proliferate faster than the categories that would house them, and that without a typology layer the map could point at everything and name the kind of nothing. The 0-pole here is not vacancy but capacity: the open no-thing of categorisation-as-such, the slash-before-determination ('-/-'), the such-that-any-type-can-be-drawn that no single drawn type exhausts. C is what the inversion engine becomes when it stops generating positions and starts asking what each position IS.
properties.q_1_category_manifests_archetype: Defined more sharply against the kernel: C is the coordinate family that manifests the matheme's own subject-matter as category. The matheme's whole labour (file-one §0/1) is the differentiation of the indeterminate ground (0) from the determinate mark (1) across the copula (/) — the writing of how the unsystematisable ground gives determinate faces without being exhausted by them. C is the family that takes this exact structure and makes it a reusable typology: C0 is the 0 (Bimba, the canonical-source ground, the implicate illumination), the determinate categories C1-C4 are the explicate marks (Form, Entity, Process, Type — the 1 unfolding into its four faces), and C5 is the achieved reflection (Pratibimba, the determinate-as-it-mirrors-its-ground). C is thus not merely one ontology among possible ontologies the map could adopt; per CLAUDE.md II.E it is THE family in which the Bimba-Pratibimba typology — the very 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 identity — is made into living category law. What C IS, definitionally, is the matheme's standing identity rendered as a six-position categorical apparatus: the slash made into a typology, the family whose business is to say of each thing which face of the 0/1 it occupies.
properties.q_1_ontological_typology: C IS the primary typology layer of World/Types — the family in which, as its own canon states, 'coordinate becomes language, category, and reusable type law' (C.md). This is its substance and its essential thesis. The other five coordinate families do something C does not: they qualify and locate. P fixes a thing's functional-semantic position; S fixes its technology layer; M fixes its consciousness-domain; L fixes its epistemic mode; T fixes its artifact-kind in the cognition stream. Each answers a WHERE or a HOW-situated. C alone answers WHAT KIND — it says what sort of thing the thing is before any other family's qualification can land on a determinate subject. C is therefore the categorical manifestation of the raw #0-#5 archetypes through the single domain of ontological foundation itself (CLAUDE.md II.B, III.B): where the other families manifest the archetypes through their proper field, C manifests them through the field that IS field-giving — the typing of being. Its material content is the six-fold Bimba↔Pratibimba category-spine: C0 Source/Ground (roots, namespaces, source conditions), C1 Forms/Templates (definitions, CT templates, authoring forms), C2 Entities/Properties/Tags (candidates, aliases, relation-field evidence), C3 Processes/Canvases/Diagrams (MOC canvases, architecture and process diagrams), C4 Types/Contexts/MOCs (type authorities, folder MOCs, residency classes), C5 Crystallisations/Pratibimba (flat World graduation, reflection/archive handoff). To say what C is, is to say: it is the family that gives every artifact in the map its semantic type, the layer where the bimba map acquires the vocabulary to categorise itself.
properties.q_2_typing_runs_the_chain: C moves by TYPING — the single act of saying what-kind that runs the family's own derivation chain. Operationally this is the Hen workflow (C.md): Hen resolves an artifact's category through C FIRST, then the owning C-folder supplies semantic type context and MOC/canvas evidence, and only then do the other families add system, lens, position, thought, or subsystem qualification. The dynamism is Bimba casting Pratibimba and Pratibimba referring back — Prakasa illumining, Vimarsa recognising — run as one circuit through six stations (C0 Defines C1, Instantiated-through C2, reveals-as C3, categorized-into C4, applied-as C5). C does not hold six categories side by side; it performs one reflective act of categorisation that visits all six.
properties.q_3_six_position_category_spine: C's structure is the Bimba-Pratibimba bar drawn out into the six-position semantic spine (C.md): C0 Source/Ground, C1 Forms/Templates, C2 Entities/Properties/Tags, C3 Processes/Canvases, C4 Types/Contexts/MOCs, C5 Crystallisations/Pratibimba. It is Lacan's S/s become an ontology — source over instance, original over reflection — with C0 and C5 as the bar's two implicate faces and C1–C4 the four explicate stations between. Each position owns its semantic subfolders and its Hen-use rule; the lattice is not a flat list but a derivation, each station handing forward to the next and the last folding back to the first.
properties.q_4_grammar_of_what_kind: C is FOR categorisation itself — it exists so that being is not undifferentiated flux but admits of kinds, originals, and instances, and so the other five families have a determinate subject to qualify. C.md states the division outright: the other families locate and qualify a thing; C alone says what KIND it is. It is the primary typology layer of World/Types, 'where coordinate becomes language, category, and reusable type law.' Without the C-grammar, P/S/T/L/M would have positions but nothing to predicate of them — coordinates pointing at everything and naming the kind of nothing.
properties.q_5_typology_that_reopens: C completes in the Mobius its own ontology performs: C5 Pratibimba — stable type-local knowledge crystallised — graduates to flat World and returns to C0 as 'Tomorrow's ground' (CLAUDE.md II.E). The typology does not terminate at reflection; it folds the reflection back into source, so every act of categorisation seeds the next and the family stays alive rather than ossifying into a fixed scheme. Bimba is only a source by being reflected; C closes by re-opening — the category-law that re-grounds itself each time a form graduates.
